CustomField.description: Deterministic evaluation order within a Policy_Version__c. Pins the sequence in which rules are fetched and evaluated so that replaying the same Audit_Case__c against the same Policy_Version__c always produces Replay_Check__c records in an identical order. Nulls sort last and fall back to Rule_Code__c ASC.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lower numbers evaluate first. Leave blank to fall back to alphabetical Rule Code ordering.
CustomField.label: Sort Order
